column4: Continue the first reference: identical overhead camera, workbench and smiling porcelain maid doll lying on her back, but now her raised right hand pinches one taut tan-gold thread and offers its end upward to a huge white-gloved puppeteer's fingertip (second reference) that reaches down into the frame from the top edge. The thread runs from her fingers to the glove. Tools stay at the edges. No text.

Low side view at the near edge of the same workbench, right at table height: above the bench top only the doll's black ruffled sleeve and resting arm are visible, while below the edge, hidden from above, her other porcelain hand with ball-jointed fingers and a wrist ring secretly touches the handle of a large pair of black dressmaker shears lying on a lower shelf in the shadow under the table. Five fingers. No text.

Overhead close-up of the same porcelain maid doll lying on the workbench, framed from her chin to her waist: the black dress bodice and white apron are folded open to the sides, revealing a smooth ivory porcelain chest plate that is fully closed, with a fine seam line down its middle and two small brass hinges. A pair of white-gloved fingertips rests on the plate's edge. No text.

Continue the reference: identical framing of the same doll's face, now still and calm, eyes half lowered, hair resting, the branching crack on her cheek plain to see. From the right edge a slender paintbrush with a white-loaded tip approaches the crack, held by white-gloved fingertips. Same flat pure chroma green (#00B140) background, clean closed outline, no strings, no text.

Low view under the workbench on the dark wooden floor: a single empty white glove lies crumpled and limp on the boards in a pool of shadow, its fingers flattened, a split seam along its back. The bench legs and drawers frame the top. No people, no text.

Close-up of a single coal-black hooded congregant in a pew, bent over an open ledger, the deep hood hiding the face completely in black shadow. On the ledger page are rows of small orange tally marks and checkboxes. Behind, a dark stone wall with a long hanging scroll covered in the same rows of tally marks. No text lettering.
